hero_swim_path_064.scope: Ordinary living Hero adult with locked Swim FIRST evolution. Full signed later axes retain nine unique corners without changing first type or biological age.
hero_swim_path_064.reference: Fresh independently operated Chao Island viewer with Swim first checkbox selected and Hero alignment. Fresh and all nine mature forms personally inspected front/side; balanced/Swim/Fly backs also inspected. Imported Hero and Swim cuboids supply block construction vocabulary only; no official imported Hero Swim model exists.
hero_swim_path_064.approximation: Four closed cuboids interpret paired white-root and two-color distal flaps around the original square skull. Source smooth arches, webbed feet and small rounded wing lobes are simplified. Run turns down/forward, Swim down/back, Power forms thick upward/back paddles, Fly raises the outer point, and mixed corners moderate these. Bilinear combinations and maturity pacing are authored approximations.
hero_swim_path_064.head_caps_policy: White/inherited root127; one upper cap per side spans proximal125 and distal126 along its actual local length, including terminal faces. No head shell, forehead stripes or band geometry.
hero_swim_path_064.wing_policy: Two small closed lobes per unchanged wing joint; fixed directions -30/+22 degrees retain exact proximal hinge [0,.25,0]. Four longitudinal faces carry root124/distal123 pigments.
hero_swim_path_064.body_contact_policy: Top-only torso extension +.45 supports scoped .35 pixel walking head lift. Original joints and shoulder anchors remain exact; compact hands and feet grow moderately.
hero_swim_path_064.tail_policy: Original small tail geometry, native UVs and attachment retained unchanged.
hero_swim_path_064.marker_policy: Square four-bar Hero halo uses original emotion_dots/emotion_dot anchors and tilt; first bar retains original atlas artwork, three mesh-only children add the remaining bars.
hero_swim_path_064.provisional_rates: 960 current level-bar progress per opposing axis; independent adult maturity. Viewer settings do not establish original game levels or timing.
